article.title: 內地雙11以AI輔助商品比較、試穿與找優惠
article.title_en: China’s Singles’ Day puts AI product comparison, try-ons and deals in the shopping journey
article.summary: 路透社報道淘寶、天貓及京東等平台的AI購物入口，實際用途包括查詢與比較。
article.summary_en: Reuters reports AI shopping entry points across platforms including Taobao, Tmall and JD, with use cases for queries and comparisons.
highlights: 阿里平台的例子包括虛擬試穿及尋找優惠。
京東稱顧客在雙11透過Dongdong購物助手查詢。
highlights_en: Alibaba examples include virtual try-ons and finding offers.
JD says shoppers used its Dongdong assistant for Singles’ Day advice.
article.why: 消費者可以用自然語言表達需求，品牌的尺寸、適用場景和優惠限制因而更值得寫清楚。
article.why_en: Natural-language queries make clear sizes, use cases and offer limits more useful to shoppers.
article.next_step: 抽查站內常見問題，核對不同商品版本的規格和優惠條款是否一致。
article.next_step_en: Review common questions and check that product variants and offer terms agree across listings.
article.detail: 路透社以各平台功能及消費者訪問呈現雙11的AI購物使用情境，當中包括淘寶用戶試穿衣物，以及京東助手處理商品查詢。這些例子說明可觀察的購物步驟，未能單獨判斷AI對整體支出的影響。品牌可分開記錄商品被發現、顧客查詢及最終下單，找出需要補充的產品資料。
article.detail_en: Reuters uses platform examples and a shopper interview to describe shopping activity, including Taobao clothing try-ons and JD assistant queries. These examples do not establish an effect on overall spend. Track discovery, questions and orders separately to see which product facts are missing.
